name: Valuation Cross-Checks and Governance
required_scope: Add a controlled peer comparison with automatic suppression of incomparable rows.
Add controlled historical valuation without look-ahead data.
Add reproducible reverse valuation using the authoritative dated market-capital or enterprise-value basis.
Add at least one reasonable independent valuation cross-check.
Require probability method, evidence, dates, sensitivity, expiration, and independent research approval.
Keep S09 price sensitivity and return permissions authoritative.
Keep Gate 4 portfolio sizing and action disabled.

automatic_suppression: Period or period-basis mismatch without a controlled bridge.
Missing peer identity or business-model-fit classification.

required_controls: Source Level 1 through 4 evidence available by the probability as-of date.
As-of date and expiration review date.
New earnings or guidance review trigger.
Downside-heavy, central, and upside-heavy sensitivity cases.
probability_governance.formal_return_boundary: Validated probability governance cannot override an incomplete S09 probability-weighted-return output.

system_wide_controls: Every material S11 calculated output receives a stable CALC evidence ID, formula, source locator, and input evidence IDs.
Persisted S11 outputs and CALC evidence are rebuilt and compared to authoritative parent data to detect tampering.
Unknown, unavailable, future, lower-priority, or mismatched evidence cannot silently satisfy a valuation input.
The renderer reads the shared contract and does not calculate valuation results.
One-Page and Full Report consume the same valuation cross-check object.
Partner-facing peer rows suppress numerical values when comparability fails.
Below Gate 3, all S11 values, evidence, source references, and dependent priced-in conclusions are removed.
Frozen schema 5.0.0 rejects injected S11 fields and remains unchanged.
No company name or ticker controls method selection, status, or conclusion.

local_review_resolutions.finding: A DCF FACT or CALC line could match evidence published after the valuation date.
local_review_resolutions.control: Exact model-line matching is now restricted to known evidence available by the valuation as-of date; unresolved or future evidence invalidates the line.

local_review_resolutions.finding: The independent DCF share denominator did not explicitly distinguish current outstanding, current diluted, and forward diluted shares.
local_review_resolutions.control: A validated share-basis type, matching basis date, exact metric evidence, rationale, and reviewer are now mandatory.

local_review_resolutions.finding: Probability methodology approval could be misread as permission to display a formal weighted return.
local_review_resolutions.control: The final permission is reconstructed from the authoritative S09 probability-weighted-return output and is tamper tested.

remote_independent_code_review.representation: No independent remote code-review conclusion is claimed.

acceptance_interpretation: S11 is accepted as a shared, fail-closed valuation-governance contract.
MULTI_METHOD_VALIDATED means the methods are reproducible and governed; it does not mean the methods agree or establish fair value.
A validated independent DCF remains a cross-check range, not a target price.
A validated probability framework does not create a formal return unless the separate S09 horizon and output also validate.
No S11 input produces NOT_PROVIDED rather than an invented peer set, historical range, DCF, or probability.
scope_boundary: S11 does not automatically select peers, acquire licensed consensus, or create analyst assumptions.
S11 does not prove that real-company peer sets, historical series, reverse assumptions, or DCF inputs are complete; that is the S12 cross-company acceptance task.
S11 does not create a target price, position size, portfolio action, or trade.
Gate 4 remains a separate private, human-approved portfolio workflow.

exact_next_starting_point.name: Valuation Cross-Company Acceptance
exact_next_starting_point.first_action: Freeze the S12 company and business-model test matrix before running real peer, history, reverse-valuation, scenario-price, and return-language acceptance cases.
